author: Brent Rossow
releaseNotes: 2.0.2: Fixed Recovery Mode switching itself off when a sensor came back after missing check-ins (the log blamed a "Platform bug"; it was a typo in 2.0.0). If you saw that warning, set Recovery Mode back to Normal and click Save Preferences. Also fixed: sensors upgraded from 1.x logged a checkPresence() error every 3 hours, and their health check never ran, until preferences were saved. They now switch over by themselves. 2.0.1: Quieter logs: raw Zigbee messages (msgMap, the hourly check-in data and multistate events) and internal method traces now log only with debug logging on. Info logging keeps the readable lines, such as temperature, humidity and pressure changes. No setting changes are needed.
